policy.decision: No current order operation proves persisted idempotency, permission-safe reconciliation, actor/session quarantine and duplicate-notification behavior as one executable end-to-end contract. PR 1.5b therefore adds no detached owner.

rows.backendCommandOwner: Orders transaction service or Bazis create-order command; legacy feature-flag path remains page-orchestrated; post-save export is a second command
rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: create/update and sheet-material permissions are server-checked on backend paths; update has optimistic order version; legacy Hasura path and post-save export do not form one atomic permission/version boundary
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Save DTO carries a stable attempt key, but mixed save modes plus the post-save export are not one persisted idempotent workflow and have no accepted-command lookup API
rows.auditHistoryContract: Backend save writes order audit/history; legacy and post-save export do not prove one correlated queryable workflow
rows.notificationOutboxContract: Success/error and export notifications are page-owned; duplicate notification behavior after remount is not proven
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No automatic retry. Exact order view remains pinned from validated submit through save completion and post-save export.
rows.reconciliation: Current page refetch/store synchronization only; no permission-safe lookup by request/idempotency key
rows.authTransition: Existing auth/resource completion guards suppress A completion in B; pin namespace is synchronously cleared and never rebound to B

rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: Server checks actor/order scope; If-Match carries current order version
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Idempotency-Key is sent, but accepted-command reconciliation after remount is not exposed
rows.auditHistoryContract: Backend command history exists; request-key query proof is missing
rows.notificationOutboxContract: Completion toast and refetch are page-owned
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No detached retry; pin until command plus authoritative refetch settles
rows.authTransition: A completion is resource-guarded and cannot publish to B

rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: orders.delete scope plus If-Match current version
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Idempotency-Key exists; no client reconciliation endpoint by key
rows.auditHistoryContract: Delete audit is backend-owned and queryable, but not wired as remount completion owner
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No automatic retry; confirmation owner pins exact view
rows.authTransition: Publication guard prevents navigation/toast under B

rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: Server checks current actor, order/client/project relation and move permission; response includes auditId/requestId
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Client key exists, but no permission-safe lookup/retry contract by key is exposed
rows.auditHistoryContract: Response has auditId/requestId and backend audit; remount reconciliation is not wired
rows.notificationOutboxContract: Toast is page-owned; outbox/duplicate-toast guarantee is not proven
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No detached retry; modal/view remain pinned through refetch
rows.authTransition: Auth/order/client/project owner tokens quarantine stale completion

rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: Server validates source/target scope and source If-Match; existing target also carries version
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Idempotency-Key exists; accepted/terminal query and retry proof are missing
rows.auditHistoryContract: Backend transaction audit exists; client reconciliation by request id is absent
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No retry; exact modal workspace pins until onDone/error
rows.authTransition: Workspace namespace cleanup plus existing completion ownership prevent B publication

rows.backendCommandOwner: Cut jobs service, but frontend orchestrates create/eligibility/add/conditional rollback as multiple boundaries
rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: cut.manage and job version checks apply per endpoint; multi-step sequence is not one command
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: No single persisted workflow idempotency key covers create/add/rollback
rows.auditHistoryContract: Per-command backend history does not prove one correlated frontend workflow
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No detached retry; pin through all steps and best-effort rollback
rows.reconciliation: Cut job reload only; possible empty-job warning requires operator action
rows.authTransition: No step may continue under B credentials; completion is not rebound

rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: Current rendered order and finance/export visibility determine included fields
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Not applicable; generated Blob/download delivery is not persisted
rows.auditHistoryContract: Not applicable for pure client export
rows.notificationOutboxContract: Browser download and completion/error toast are page-owned
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No automatic retry; pin until worker/download settles
rows.reconciliation: Not applicable; operator can explicitly export again
rows.authTransition: Resource guard suppresses stale A download/toast publication where asynchronous

rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: orders.export plus finance visibility are checked server-side
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Not applicable to read-only export; browser file delivery is not persisted
rows.auditHistoryContract: Read/export audit may exist, but no download reconciliation contract
rows.notificationOutboxContract: Browser download and toast are page-owned
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No detached retry; pin through download delivery
rows.authTransition: Order/auth guard suppresses A completion in B

rows.backendCommandOwner: Not applicable: parser mutates only the local order draft; persistence happens later through order-save
rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: Current draft owner and later save permission/version contract
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Not applicable; parsed workbook/file are bounded in-memory attachments
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No background continuation after close; pin while parsing and require explicit reattach after reload
rows.reconciliation: Checkpoint restores serializable wizard state; browser File must still exist in current namespace
rows.authTransition: Logout/scope revoke releases file/workbook and clears pin before B render

rows.backendCommandOwner: Not applicable: local parser and draft mutation
rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: Current draft owner and later order-save contract
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Not applicable; File and parser state are bounded in-memory/checkpoint data
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No detached retry; pin parse/layout confirmation
rows.reconciliation: Serializable checkpoint only; reload requests file reattachment
rows.authTransition: A file/parser/pin state is synchronously cleared before B

rows.backendCommandOwner: VLM upload/analyze service plus page-owned parse/draft application
rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: Current actor upload/analyze access; draft persistence uses later order-save contract
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: No persisted end-to-end idempotency/reconciliation across upload, analyze and draft apply
rows.auditHistoryContract: Analyze request may be logged; no queryable workflow relation to later save
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No detached retry; pin entire importFromImage promise
rows.reconciliation: Serializable result can checkpoint in current session; reload requires reattach/restart
rows.authTransition: Auth cleanup releases photo and pin; stale completion cannot publish to B

rows.surface: order show/edit labels data and generation
rows.backendCommandOwner: Labels service; generation is a page-orchestrated preview/generate/download sequence
rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: labels permissions, order scope, row/template versions and preview token are server-checked
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Writes send idempotency keys, but the full preview/generate/download workflow has no one-key reconciliation API
rows.auditHistoryContract: Backend label generations are queryable; label-data plus delivery correlation is incomplete for detachment
rows.notificationOutboxContract: Download/toast are page-owned; duplicate delivery proof is missing
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No retry under a new owner; pin through write/generation/download
rows.reconciliation: Latest generation can be reloaded explicitly, but in-flight completion is not reconciled by request key
rows.authTransition: Live auth/order owner token suppresses stale A state, blob and toast in B

rows.backendCommandOwner: Production actions service when enabled; legacy feature-flag path remains direct page-owned mutation
rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: Backend commands validate actor/order scope, version and idempotency; detail activation and legacy paths do not share one version contract
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Backend rows are idempotent, but legacy compatibility and missing accepted-command lookup prevent safe generic detachment
rows.auditHistoryContract: Backend response includes audit data; legacy path and cross-mode reconciliation are incomplete
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No detached retry; hook pins exact workspace for activate/deactivate/detail commands
rows.authTransition: Existing auth/resource owner prevents A response publication under B

rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: groups.manage_links, order visibility and link version are server-checked
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Request includes idempotency key; no permission-safe accepted-command lookup is exposed to remounted UI
rows.auditHistoryContract: Response/backend contains audit and relation history; request-key reconciliation is not wired
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No detached retry; exact order workspace remains pinned
rows.authTransition: Write completion token is auth/order scoped and cannot update B

rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: deadline override permission, actor/order scope and reason validation are server-owned
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: No client-visible accepted-command state or reconciliation key is available
rows.auditHistoryContract: Deadline events/audit are queryable after reload, but not correlated to an in-flight remount owner
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No detached retry; pin exact order view through save and panel reload trigger
rows.authTransition: Order/auth write token suppresses A completion under B

rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: Order update and HDF configuration permissions are server-checked; client requires a clean saved draft
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: No explicit persisted idempotency/reconciliation key is exposed
rows.auditHistoryContract: Saved order response is authoritative, but remount lookup by command is absent
rows.notificationOutboxContract: Store sync and toast are page-owned
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No automatic retry; pin through response-to-draft synchronization

rows.surface: order show/edit Telegram screenshots and manual SVG files
rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: Current actor and exact order/file/packet access are checked on each request
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Restore may be backend-deduplicated, but accepted restore and browser delivery are not one reconciled client workflow
rows.auditHistoryContract: Worker audit/history exists; page does not reconcile a request key after remount
rows.notificationOutboxContract: Polling, object URL/download and errors are page-owned
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No detached retry; pin restore and exact download delivery
rows.authTransition: Auth/order/file owner tokens prevent A blob/state publication under B

rows.backendCommandOwner: Bazis cut set command service; existing-set flow is frontend get-version then add
rows.permissionScopeVersionContract: cut.manage/order scope plus expected set version on add-to-existing
rows.persistedIdempotencyContract: Create/add accept keys, but two-path modal flow has no common accepted-command reconciliation owner
rows.auditHistoryContract: Backend set audit exists; request-key remount proof is missing
rows.abortRetryPolicy: No detached retry; pin exact originating order view
rows.authTransition: Pin and completion remain bound to original auth namespace/order

promotionGate.measurementRule: operation_eviction_pin_count increments only when the bounded eviction owner actually encounters an active page-owned pin, not merely when a normal operation starts
promotionGate.note: A session with an eviction pin or checkpoint circuit breaker remains functional under the old mounting policy but is ineligible for cohort promotion evidence.
